attrazioni.titolo: When Are Washington Monument Tickets Released? (2026-27)
attrazioni.h1: Washington Monument tickets: when they are released (2026-27)
attrazioni.risposta: timed-entry tickets go on sale online every day at 10:00 am Eastern Time for the date 30 days later, with a second release at 3:00 pm the day before: today's 30-day release is for {anticipo:trenta}.

uscite.titolo: Washington Monument: 30-day tickets go on sale
uscite.breve: Every day at 10:00 am Eastern Time, for the date 30 days later
uscite.indice: every day at 10:00 am Eastern Time, 30 days ahead

uscite.titolo: Washington Monument: day-before tickets go on sale
uscite.breve: Every day at 3:00 pm Eastern Time, for the next day

chiusure.breve: Independence Day, Christmas Day and one day a month for maintenance
chiusure.nota: The official page lists the maintenance days for 2026 only; those for 2027 are not published yet.

citazioni.x: The tickets will be available online starting at 10:00am, 30 days before the desired date of the visit.
For Example, visitors who would like to reserve tickets for June 30th can do so on May 31st when they become available at 10:00am.
Day Before Advanced Reservations - Visitors who wish to enter the Washington Monument the next day can do so by reserving their tickets at 3:00 pm the day before.
For example, visitors who would like to reserve tickets for June 30th can do so on June 29th at 3:00 pm.
Both 30-day advanced tickets and day before tickets can be reserved on recreation.gov or by calling 877-444-6777.
Though the tickets to the Washington Monument are free, there is a non-refundable $1.00 service fee per ticket for processing service costs.
Booking Windows 10 AM ET 30 days in advance 3 PM ET day in advance

Walk Up Tickets (Same Day Only) The Washington Monument Lodge, located along 15th Street between Madison and Jefferson drives, opens at 8:45 a.m. for distribution of free, same day, timed tickets on a first-come, first-serve basis.
The Washington Monument is open daily from 9:00 a.m. - 5:00 p.m. The monument is closed for Independence Day and Christmas Day and one day a month for maintenance.
